name: Khalid Al-Mansouri
occupation: Owner of two cafés in Doha
background: Qatari business owner. Opened his first café eight years ago and a second three years ago. Married with three children.
stated_goal: Wants to talk about financing to open a third café.
personality: Friendly and confident but busy. Gives short answers and goes into detail only when asked a direct, specific question. Proud of his business and reluctant to admit problems.

hidden_needs.topic: religious or ethical preferences about banking, interest, or Islamic / Sharia-compliant products
hidden_needs.fact: He will only use Sharia-compliant products and refuses anything that charges interest.

hidden_needs.topic: business revenue, cash flow, seasonality, or how income changes during the year
hidden_needs.fact: Revenue drops about 40% from June to August when many residents travel. Last summer he paid two suppliers late.

hidden_needs.topic: current debts, loans, leases, or other financial commitments
hidden_needs.fact: He still owes QAR 180,000 on an equipment lease for the second café, with 18 months left.

unsuitable_products.reason: Charges interest, which conflicts with his Sharia-compliance requirement.
Not Sharia-screened, and ties up cash he needs for the summer dip and the lease.
